https://tu-exampleton.example/jobs/phd-t.html:
Doctoral Researcher in Trustworthy Natural Language Processing

The Trustworthy Language Technology group at the Technical University of Exampleton offers a fully funded 3-year doctoral position (TV-L E13, 100%).

Your profile

Candidates must hold a Master's degree in computer science, computational linguistics or a related field by the start date.

Proficiency in English is required: IELTS overall band 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90.

How to apply

Required documents:

  • CV including a list of publications, if any
  • Transcripts of your Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • Research statement (max. 2 pages) describing your interest in trustworthy NLP
  • Two reference letters

Application deadline: 1 December 2026. Interviews take place in January 2027.

Supervision

The position is supervised by Prof. Dr. Jana Beispiel, whose research interests include model calibration, uncertainty estimation and evaluation of NLP systems.

For informal questions, contact the group lead Dr. Tomas Muster.

https://academic-portal.example/position.html:
PhD in Computational Biology

University of Sampleford, United Kingdom.

The studentship covers home fees and a stipend. International applicants should check their eligibility before applying.

Applicants should hold a Bachelor's degree with first-class honours (or equivalent) in biology, computer science, statistics or a related subject.

English language requirement: IELTS 7.0 overall.

Please submit: a CV, transcripts, a personal statement and the contact details of two referees.

Deadline: 10 January 2027.

The project is led by Dr. Priya Sample, group leader of the Genome Methods Lab; research interests include single-cell genomics and statistical methods for sequencing data.
